eyebrow: The model that actually runs the internet
code:
Application      HTTP, DNS, SMTP, FTP
Transport        TCP, UDP (ports)
Internet         IP, ICMP (routing)
Network Access   Ethernet, Wi-Fi
caption: Four layers, bottom to top — real networks run this, not OSI.

code:
OSI 7/6/5 (App/Pres/Session) --> TCP/IP Application
OSI 4 (Transport)             --> TCP/IP Transport
OSI 3 (Network)                --> TCP/IP Internet
OSI 2/1 (Data Link/Physical)  --> TCP/IP Network Access
caption: The mapping used across the industry — not a clean 1:1 split.
